dialogue.content: こんにちは　こちらはカウンセリングの希死念慮です　よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello. This is the Suicidal Ideation Counseling service. Thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for speaking with me.

dialogue.content: ご相談について、話しやすいところからお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Regarding what you'd like to discuss, could you please start wherever feels most comfortable for you?

dialogue.content: はい、生きるのが辛いです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's painful to live.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　辛い気持ちについて、もう少し詳しくお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Would it be alright if I asked a bit more about those painful feelings?

dialogue.content: はい、周りに否定されて生きる意味がわからなくなりました
dialogue.English: Yes, I've been rejected by those around me, and I've lost sight of the meaning of life.

dialogue.content: 周りに否定。。それはとての悲しいですね　どんなことがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Being rejected by others... that sounds incredibly sad. Could you tell me more about what happened?

dialogue.content: 会社の会議で自分が意見したらそれは違うの一点張りで受け入れてもらえなかったんです、
dialogue.English: At a company meeting, when I shared my opinion, they just kept insisting it was wrong and wouldn't accept it.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　とても辛い経験をされましたね
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been a very painful experience for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんな会議だったのか、もう少し教えていただいてもよろしいでしょうか…
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a little more about what kind of meeting it was...?

dialogue.content: 新しい事業について何があるかということについてですね
dialogue.English: It was about discussing potential new business ventures.

dialogue.content: 私はいくつか良さそうなやつを考えていたのですが全員で却下されました
dialogue.English: I had thought of a few promising ideas, but they were all rejected by everyone.

dialogue.content: 全員でなんてひどい　せっかく考えて提案したのに、悔しいですね
dialogue.English: By everyone? That's awful. After you put in the effort to come up with and propose those ideas, it must have been so frustrating.

dialogue.content: そうですね、悔しいもありますね
dialogue.English: Yes, I do feel frustrated as well.

dialogue.content: はい　却下されたときはどんな気持ちだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. How did you feel when your ideas were rejected?

dialogue.content: なんで可能性のある意見がないんだろうって思いました
dialogue.English: I wondered why they couldn't see any potential in my ideas.

dialogue.content: そうですよね　何か意見をいただきたかったですよね　何かあなた自身、却下されたことについて意見することはできましたか？
dialogue.English: That makes sense. You would have liked some feedback. Were you able to say anything yourself about the rejection?

dialogue.content: 意見することすらできませんでした
dialogue.English: I couldn't even voice my opinion.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　何か意見できない雰囲気だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Was there an atmosphere that made it difficult to speak up?

dialogue.content: 雰囲気というか気持ちの問題ですね
dialogue.English: It was less the atmosphere and more about my own feelings.

dialogue.content: 雰囲気もあるかもですが
dialogue.English: Though the atmosphere might have played a part, too.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか　気持ちと言いますとどのような？
dialogue.English: I see. What kind of feelings do you mean?

dialogue.content: 受け入れてもらえてないという落ち込みですかね
dialogue.English: The feeling of being down from not being accepted, I suppose.

dialogue.content: 落ち込んでしまうほど、ショックだったのですね
dialogue.English: It was such a shock that it left you feeling deeply down.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 違うとの一点張りで意見を受け入れてもらえなければ、生きる意味がわからなくなってしまうのも自然なことかと思います
dialogue.English: If your opinions are flatly rejected as wrong without being accepted, it's natural to lose sight of the meaning of life.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: こうやって今日ここに相談に来て下さったので、あなたの支えになれたらと感じています。
dialogue.English: Since you came here to talk today, I hope I can be a source of support for you.

dialogue.content: 今日一番、ここでご相談したいことはどんなことでしょうか
dialogue.English: What is the main thing you would like to discuss here today?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。否定された時の立ち直り方が知りたいです。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I’d like to know how to bounce back when I’m rejected.

dialogue.content: 否定されたときの立ち直り方ですね！大事ですものね　一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: How to recover from rejection. That's very important, isn't it? Let's explore that together.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までも、自分の意見が否定されたり同じようにショックをうけたことはありましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever had your opinions rejected or felt a similar shock before?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、じつはあまり思い出せないんです
dialogue.English: Let me see… to be honest, I can’t really remember.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか　無理に思い出さなくても大丈夫です
dialogue.English: I see. It's okay, you don't have to force yourself to remember.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今回の件について、こんなにも落ち込んでいるということを、どなたかにお話しはされましたか？
dialogue.English: Regarding this incident, have you talked to anyone about how much it has left you feeling down?

dialogue.content: 話してないですね
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: 同じ職場の同僚は、会議の様子知っている方いらっしゃいませんか？
dialogue.English: Are there any colleagues from your workplace who know what happened in the meeting?

dialogue.content: 同僚はいませんでしたね
dialogue.English: There were no colleagues there.

dialogue.content: 私以外みんな役員の方だったので
dialogue.English: Everyone besides me was an executive.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　役員ばかりとは、とても重要な会議だったのですね
dialogue.English: I see. If it was all executives, it must have been a very important meeting.

dialogue.content: そうですね、会社の未来を作ることでしたので
dialogue.English: Yes, it was about shaping the company's future.

dialogue.content: 未来を創る会議に参加されていたことは、あなたはとても有能な方だと感じます。
dialogue.English: The fact that you were participating in a meeting to shape the future makes me feel that you are a very capable person.

dialogue.content: 役員の方達は意見を否定しながらも、ちょっとでも今後に生かせるようなご意見はありませんでしたか？
dialogue.English: While the executives were rejecting your ideas, did they offer any feedback, even a little, that could be useful for the future?

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？あれは手を挙げた人なら誰でも参加できるものですよ
dialogue.English: Do you think so? Anyone who volunteered could have participated in that.

dialogue.content: その意見はありませんでしたね
dialogue.English: No, there was no such feedback.

dialogue.content: それでも、手を挙げて参加されたあなたは会社にとって価値ある方だと感じます。手尾挙げない人もいたでしょうから
dialogue.English: Even so, by volunteering to participate, I feel you are valuable to the company. I'm sure there were people who didn't volunteer.

dialogue.content: そう思っていただけてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me that way.

dialogue.content: ただ無駄な時間だったみたいなオーラが見えました
dialogue.English: But I could sense an aura from them like it was a waste of time.

dialogue.content: 役員の方から
dialogue.English: From the executives.

dialogue.content: そんな風に感じられたのですね　今回は否定されて落ち込んだとしても、会社の未来作る会議に参加されたことは、意味あることと思います。
dialogue.English: I see that's how it felt to you. Even if you were rejected and felt down this time, I believe that participating in a meeting to shape the company's future was a meaningful thing to do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: こう考えてはいかがでしょうか。。役員の考えや会社の方向性を少しでもしることが出来た、これからの仕事に生かそうと。
dialogue.English: How about thinking of it this way... that you were able to learn a little about the executives' way of thinking and the company's direction, and you can use that in your work going forward.

dialogue.content: なかなか難しいです
dialogue.English: That's quite difficult.

dialogue.content: そう思う理由をお聞きしてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I ask why you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 先程のようなプラス思考に考えがいかないっていう感じですね
dialogue.English: It feels like I just can’t shift my thinking toward the kind of positive outlook you mentioned.

dialogue.content: なかなか思考を変えるのは難しいですものね
dialogue.English: It's certainly difficult to change your way of thinking, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話をお聞きしていて、あなたはいくつものアイデアを意見していますよね。例え否定されたとしても発想力が豊かな方だと感じます。
dialogue.English: Listening to your story, I hear that you proposed several ideas. Even if they were rejected, it shows me you’re someone with a rich creativity.

dialogue.content: 言われてみればそうかもしれません
dialogue.English: Now that you mention it, that might be true.

dialogue.content: ただ自分でもこれはどうだろう？ってものもありました
dialogue.English: But there were some that I had my own doubts about.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　それでも、提案しないよりは提案した方がいいです　絶対に
dialogue.English: I see. Even so, it’s better to propose than not to—absolutely.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分の中で諦めてしまったら可能性はそこでおしまいですもの　自分で限界を決めてしまってはもったいないです
dialogue.English: If you give up within yourself, the possibilities end right there. It's a waste to set your own limits.

dialogue.content: はあ
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 発言して提案して、ダメだったらまた考えるの繰り返しが大事だと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I think it's important to keep repeating the cycle of speaking up, proposing ideas, and if it doesn't work out, thinking again. What do you think?

dialogue.content: それもそうですね、しかしダメだったら考えるという切り替えが辛いんです
dialogue.English: That's true, but it's painful for me to make that mental switch to 'think again' after being shot down.

dialogue.content: もしダメだったとしても、自分はよくやったのではないですか？一生懸命準備したり取り組んできましたよね　それを褒めてあげてほしいです
dialogue.English: Even if it didn't work out, didn't you do your best? You prepared diligently and engaged earnestly. I hope you can praise yourself for that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.
